senses.gloss:
खपुर m. (-रः)
 1. The betel tree, (Areca faufel or catechu.)
 2. A fragrant
grass, (Cyperus pertenuis.)
 3. Garlic.
 4. Flatulence.
 n. (-रं)
 1. A
water jar.
 2. A city in the sky, the city of HARISCHANDRA.
 E. ख
the heavens, &c. पृ to nourish, affix क.

खापगा f. (-गा) A name of GANGA or the Ganges.
 E. ख heaven, and अपगा
a river.
